blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A student of the Holy Infant Academy (HIA) in Calapan City brought home multiple awards from international and national academic competitions, including garnering the Grand Slam at the Asian Science and Math Olympiad (ASMO). Warren Wade A. Casuga received the ASMO Grand Slam Award during the International Champions in Education (ICE) Year-End Awarding Ceremony held on Nov. 14 at the University of the Philippines Diliman in Quezon City.
